records.question: Mandy has three $20 bills while Manny has two $50 bills. If both of them decide to exchange their bills for $10 bills, how many more $10 bills than Mandy will Manny have?
records.response:
Mandy has 3 x $20 = $60.
Manny has 2 x $50 = $100.
Mandy will have $60 / $10 = 6 $10 bills.
Manny will have $100 / $10 = 10 $10 bills.
10 - 6 = 4 more $10 bills than Mandy will Manny have.
#### 4
